messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Inputfile upload problem: <!DOCTYPE HTML> <html lang - "en"><head>
parts:
The app works fine locally on my computer, and uploads with deployApp() without issues. In the cloud everything works as long as I use very small input files. Specifically, I can only upload very small files (e.g. 7KB), and the uploader fails at even 83K csv files. The problem is replicated on the file upload demo site here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/upload-file.html. I can upload this file, which is 7KB, but not the one I actually want to use, which is 391K. The file structures are the same--the second one just has more rows of data. The larger one gives an error, which I can read on the javascript console: "requesty (sic) body in temp file not supported." It does the same thing in Chrome and IE for me. Is this a limitation on my account at shinyapp.io? I can't find out anything about that on the site. Screen caps below.
